title: I Spent 3 days just for this tiny market in my game. A market full of NPCs, stories and sidequests. Planning and writing NPCs story and progression is fun.
author: Fluffy-Discussion166

comments.author: thoughtlow
comments.body: looks pretty cool, the portraits throw me off a bit, personally would like those more in similar artstyle as the game itself or something.

replies.author: Agile_Branch_8743
replies.body: Yeah I would replace the realistic portraits to something closer to the game's art.

comments.author: ShuckForJustice
comments.body: what is your workflow for planning and writing NPC stories?

replies.author: Fluffy-Discussion166
replies.body:
listed out all the potential NPCs, gave them a simple character bible, and brainstormed interesting stories or quests for them.
I also asked Claude to suggest some ideas, but they usually aren't that interesting
